verdict.rationale: Docs mention configurable version history/retention and delta/change-notification tracking of deletions (onedrive-docs-8, onedrive-docs-23, onedrive-docs-6), but there's no documented user-facing retention policy or deletion-control API tailored to an AI-native workflow, and multiple hands-on community reports describe files being unrecoverably deleted, silently reverted to old versions, or destroyed during sync with 'no way to recover' (onedrive-comm-5, onedrive-comm-13, onedrive-comm-16), directly contradicting reliable control over retention/deletion. missing for 10: explicit user/API-level retention & deletion controls, GDPR-style erasure support, and evidence these controls work reliably in practice.
